G58's reading 1, stated while reading D07's 52 link lines (windows l001_000 and l001_026, with full how), before their rows are written; not an amendment. (1) D07's question names what the episode leaves behind 'brought in by being seen', its predicate names acts that 'return something of the canvas work into the community beyond the clock', and its third-order themes T3-044 (the mark brings outsiders to the sub; members welcome them, advertise the sub on the canvas or count the newcomers) and T3-196 (the mark draws lapsed fans back) sit in it. So a link from the mark's being seen to a newcomer or a returning fan, welcomed or advertised for, is held by the question and is a specification naming D07, whatever dimension the source lifts to (e.g. natsume c0003, parahumans c0052, monstercat c0210, tagpro c0010); so is a newcomer then taking part in the community's ordinary business (androidgaming c0034, satania c0107). D07 claims no timing for being brought in: the returns that come while placement runs (counting c0065 at h+11.97, furry c0105 at h+30.93) are noted for the census, not ruled as elaborations. (2) Explaining the event to members after the close, and pushing its joke into search results, carry the canvas work into the community beyond the clock, the predicate's words, so they are specifications naming the predicate (drumcorps c0145, frankocean c0146, timbers c0070, witcher c0085, crusaderkings c0183). (3) Two dependences no part of the model states, each made by more than one room: dealings between rooms (help, accommodation, co-operation) bringing the other room's members in as subscribers or fans (funhaus c0262, harrypotter c0298, minnesotavikings c0304), and the mark's being seen bringing in hands for the room's own work while it is up, through a tag that funnels viewers to the plan or a lapsed fan who starts defending it (AmericanFlaginPlace c0018 and c0262, strangerthings c0087); A01 states only the room's call bringing members, and no arrow runs from D07 into D01 or D03. Each is a paired elaboration. Three more rooms show returners helping in their concepts while their lines claim only the return (metalcore c0147, mindcrack c0048, schoolidolfestival c0063); they stay specifications, and the census names them. (4) A newcomer's congratulation on a university admission is not a canvas return (berkeley-058, an evidence limit). A newcomer driven away by the game's report enforcement makes integration depend on the community's rules, shown in one room only (tagpro-053, a particular); the fear of an influx that breaks rules is T3-189's (scp). counting-055 is NONPORTABLE (G6). G58's reading 2, stated after reading D02's 38 lines (link windows l003_000 and l003_017, add-condition a001, add-step s002, restrict r037), D01's 18 (a001, l004, r018) and the lines of D05 (7), D03 (3), D06 (2), D04 (1) and D08 (1), with full how, before their rows are written; not an amendment. (1) D02. Its predicate names 'the chat that decides', and its themes T3-014 (moving planning into a chat: setting it up, sharing invites and sending members there), T3-107 (keeping planning in the thread), T3-114 (disputing the chat's authority: who is left out) and T3-152 (bringing the chat's decisions back to the thread) hold a chat set up, invites shared or renewed, plans and decisions relayed to the thread, a plan given in the thread to a helper outside the chat, and calls that send helpers into the chat; these links are specifications naming D02 (e.g. DestinyTheGame c0239, mcgill c0009, furry c0164, thenetherlands c0341, fullcommunism c0039). A star change reverted by keepers who were not told, answered by a request for a chat, is P05's clause (texas c0116, c0288). A host's moderator binding where canvas talk happens, and pinning the plans thread, are P20's (borussiadortmund c0088, italy c0101); attempted orders, refusals and votes are C01's (4chan c0058, SquareSpiral c0061); a host's leave directing where the room builds is P19's (hongkong c0028); a later canvas is P13's (TheFarLeftSide c0662); help and spare accounts that start the work are P16's and A06's bound (asexuality c0080). Two dependences no part of the model states, each in more than one room: the host sub's line or frame on canvas talk sending the room's coordination to another venue (de c0284, c0495; serbia c0001, c0037), which the head lists as an open P20 edge; and strain on the work, from neighbours squeezing it, vandals outrunning repairs or failed negotiation, given as the reason to move coordination into a chat (vermont c0018, wales c0043 and c0044, virginiatech c0057). Each is a paired elaboration. A request for a school supervisor is not coordination of the work (ibo-038, an evidence limit); counting-013 is NONPORTABLE. (2) D01. Explaining the canvas while placement runs is its predicate's 'teaching them how', and admiring another room's organisation is its question's reading of numbers (canucks c0008, planetside c0069, chile c0015): specifications naming D01. Explaining the canvas after the close cannot bear on hands; D07's predicate holds it, as reading 1 ruled (kerbalspaceprogram c0223, malaysia c0206, mechanicalkeyboards c0200, rocketbeans c0143), so those links, the three add-condition lines that add the same condition (cowchop c0066, spain c0102, torontoraptors c0155) and the restrict line that narrows D01 to it (ucf c0106) are specifications naming D07; none corrects D01, whose predicate admits only acts that bear on hands (G9). That T3-016 holds explanations on both sides of the close is a placement question for D4. Keeping a visible sign or core so that it recruits hands is the dependence reading 1 found under D07, made here by three rooms (afip c0015, thebluecorner c0245 and c0549, theblackvoid c0460 and c1585): a paired elaboration. (3) The small dimensions. D05: a moral line drawn with the logo, a quarrel over a joke about the fandom, and identity formed through the canvas (alliance, battle) are what its predicate states ('a membership the room brings to the canvas or forms on it') (canucks c0184, porterrobinson c0025, partyparrot c0129, theitalyplace c0311); a canvas result carried into the rivalry's campus joke is K04's range (osu c0136); refusing to move because the tree's meaning is tied to its spot is one room's (TreePlace c0025, a particular); counting-029 is NONPORTABLE. D03: work announced up and then kept is A03 (vim c0007); a move that exposes the held spot to others is one room's (predators c0063, a particular); count recovery in the counting chain keeps the sub's ordinary business, not the work (counting-018, an evidence limit). D06: a joke tying the price to the logo and slogans spelled in the sub's own listing lay a play frame over the event in the host's space, its question's words (bitcoin c0343, leagueoflegends c0651). D04: renewed negotiations and alliances on a successor canvas are P13's (TheFarLeftSide c0676, c0682). D08: covering a rival's work and the fight told after it are its predicate's acts; the line's call to remap concepts is a rule for coding, ruled by the concepts (chile c0138).
